messages:
sara_acme: Hey team, customer (Acme) reporting our Embeddings Usage chart shows units as 'vectors' but the reported billing is ~2x what the chart suggests. They attached a screenshot and say the numbers don't match their invoice.

maria_support: Sorry about that, @sara_acme. Can you drop the screenshot and the API request example from the customer?

sara_acme: Screenshot: https://uploads.internal/acme/embeds_spike.png
Request example: ```POST /v1/embeddings
{
  model: \"redwood-embed-4b\",
  input: [\"doc1\", \"doc2\"],
  encoding: \"utf-8\"\}```
They also sent their raw usage CSV.

maria_support: Thanks. Repro steps from their CSV: they show 1200 "vectors" used on 2026-02-10 but billing tokens show ~2400 embed-token-units.

rajiv_eng_analytics: pinging eng-analytics, looks like a pipeline mismatch. Quick guess: dashboard agg is counting request count *per-batch* as vectors, while billing counts tokens across batched inputs. Could double-count when batch-size metadata is aggregated twice.

luke_sre: Any errors in the logs around the ingestion time? metrics-bot: new-metric-ingest 1783456850: ingest_success count=1 src=embed-service batch_size=2 vectors_ingested=2 tokens=1344

rajiv_eng_analytics: Can you paste the query that builds the "Embeddings Usage" chart? I want to check whether we use tokens or vectors as the unit.

maria_support: QA gave me this simplified query snippet from dashboard service: ```SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) as day, sum(events.count) as units FROM metrics.events WHERE metric_name IN ('embeds.vectors','embeds.tokens') GROUP BY day;```

rajiv_eng_analytics: aha. There's the problem — the chart aggregates both metrics together but labels the axis "vectors". If both series were tagged and then collapsed, that can add tokens+vectors. Looks like a join was accidentally summing both metric_name types.

emma_billing: Confirming billing uses embeds.tokens exclusively for invoice calculations. If the analytics query summed both, that explains the ~2x.

maria_support: Good catch. Can we reproduce quickly on staging?

rajiv_eng_analytics: Repro steps I ran locally: 1) simulate 10 requests with batch_size=2 -> metrics show embeds.vectors=20 and embeds.tokens=total_token_count 2) run the dashboard query that SUMs metric types -> result = vectors+tokens 3) label remains 'vectors' so it looked like vectors were double. I have a small fix: change the WHERE clause to metric_name = 'embeds.vectors' for that chart.

luke_sre: Also noticed our ingestion pipeline emits a derived metric 'embeds.combined_units' for some backfilled customers. That may have caused older dashboards to show inflated numbers after the backfill job on 2026-02-09. Backfill job id: fb-20260209-23.

maria_support: Action items: 1) Rajiv to open PR to tighten query and update chart label. 2) Luke to check the backfill job for which customers got 'embeds.combined_units' emitted and produce a list. 3) Emma to coordinate with Billing to determine if any invoices need adjustment or notes. 4) Support to notify Acme with ETA.

rajiv_eng_analytics: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/dashboard/pull/4821 — fixes WHERE clause and adds test. Deployment today to staging.

luke_sre: I found 18 orgs affected by the backfill; started a backfill-rollback audit to remove 'embeds.combined_units' from metrics store for those orgs.

emma_billing: I'll run an invoice diff for Acme and the other 18 orgs; early look suggests billing was correct (tokens), but the dashboard label is misleading. If any customer was charged wrongly due to pipeline bug, we'll remediate.

maria_support: Customer update: "Thanks for investigating — please confirm when dashboard reflects vectors only and we can close the ticket." I'll wait for confirmation before closing.

rajiv_eng_analytics: Staging looks good. Deploying fix to prod in 30m. After deploy, I'll post the chart query and the exact commit hash.

luke_sre: Prod deploy done, removed combined_units for affected orgs. metrics-bot: metric-cleanup 1783457050: removed_metric_count=18 metric_name='embeds.combined_units'

rajiv_eng_analytics: Confirmed prod chart now shows vectors-only and matches expected numbers for Acme's CSV. Commit: 9f3b2c1.

maria_support: Emma, any billing follow-up?

emma_billing: Acme invoices unchanged. No overcharge. I'll mark billing as OK for now; will reopen if customers dispute.

sara_acme: Confirmed with Acme — dashboard now lines up with invoice. They appreciate the quick turnaround. :tada:

maria_support: Great. Closing loop: root cause = dashboard query incorrectly summing both 'embeds.tokens' and 'embeds.vectors' and a prior backfill created a 'combined' metric that inflated some org dashboards. Fixes: query restriction + cleanup + add dashboard unit label tests.

rajiv_eng_analytics: I'll add a monitoring alert if embeds.vectors / embeds.tokens ratio crosses 1.5 for an org (likely sign of query bug).

maria_support: Thanks everyone. I'll update the support ticket and send Acme the postmortem summary."
